name: mystmd@1.13.0
body:
([full changelog](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/compare/mystmd@1.12.0...a159a3f26870d712061f2bc9860f0f19a4ced08c))

## API and Breaking Changes

- Add 'searchable' attribute on page entries [#2976](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/2976) ([@parmentelat](https://github.com/parmentelat), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))

## Bugs fixed

- Restore hidden pages in site manifest [#3139](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3139) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Unify Node version requirements [#3137](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3137) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Add `class` to card directive [#3123](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3123) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- 🐛 Fix remaining quadratic memory growth in site builds [#3116](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3116) ([@Anteru](https://github.com/Anteru), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@claude](https://github.com/claude), [@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv))
- 🐛 Skip project-wide export lookup for pages without downloads [#3115](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3115) ([@Anteru](https://github.com/Anteru), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@claude](https://github.com/claude), [@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv))
- Manually call the link command w/ npm run link [#3110](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3110) ([@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))

## Maintenance and upkeep improvements

- Disable hidden pages tests temporarily [#3141](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3141) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Normalize reference identifier once per lookup [#3135](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3135) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Return frozen store state from selectors without deep copies [#3134](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3134) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))

## Other merged PRs

- 🚀 Release [#3120](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3120) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
